overview_description.description: Loyal is a veterinary biotechnology company that develops pharmaceutical therapies for dogs aimed at extending their healthy lifespan and delaying age-associated diseases. It researches and formulates drug candidates designed to address the biological mechanisms of aging in different dog populations, including senior and large-breed dogs, with products progressing through clinical and regulatory pathways. Loyal engages in clinical studies and collaborates with veterinary professionals to advance its therapeutic programs and share scientific insights with the broader field. The company publishes research summaries to support transparency and enable other practitioners to build on its findings.

about_short_description.short_description: Loyal is a clinical-stage veterinary medicine company dedicated to extending the healthy lifespan of senior dogs.

product.name: LOY-002
product.description: A once-daily prescription pill in development for dogs aged 10+ and weighing at least 14 lb. It is intended to extend healthy lifespan by improving insulin sensitivity and lowering insulin levels.

product.name: LOY-001
product.description: A prescription long-acting injectable drug in development for large and giant dogs aged 7+ and weighing at least 40 lb. It targets IGF-1 overexpression associated with shorter lifespan in larger dogs.

product.name: LOY-003
product.description: A prescription daily pill in development for large and giant dogs aged 5+ and weighing at least 60 lb. It targets IGF-1 overexpression associated with shorter lifespan in larger dogs.

product.name: Loyal Learning Hub
product.description: An online continuing-education platform for veterinary professionals, offering on-demand courses about canine aging, senior-dog medicine, and related veterinary care topics.

product.name: STAY Clinical Study
product.description: A nationwide, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical study evaluating LOY-002’s safety and effectiveness in senior dogs in real-world veterinary settings.
